This momentum directly challenges the narrative of long-term destruction, suggesting the business is currently undergoing a fundamental turnaround that the market is beginning to price in [E4]. Furthermore, the P/E of -85x [E5] is a lagging indicator that fails to capture the value inherent in the company’s assets, which are currently priced at a discount to the sector benchmark [E6]. By trading at a P/B of 1.62x [E1], the stock remains attractively positioned relative to the sector median [E6], providing a margin of safety that the bear’s focus on historical earnings ignores.
